messages:
donna: Planning HelixFlow dedicated cutover tonight 00:30 UTC. Quiet window 00:00-01:30. Target pool HF-4. Need infra/sre/cs/sec ack before I lock.

deploybot: Runbook + checklist: https://go/runbooks/helixflow-dedicated-swap. Checks: capacity, certs, smoke, image, canary-suite, sec-audit.

felix (platform): Reserved capacity allocated (HF-4). No conflicting infra ops. Networking preflight passed. :white_check_mark:

security-bot: Automated security scan: no high findings for pinned image rwinference:v2026-07-11. Note: minor SCA warnings (low) unrelated to runtime.

rachel (sre): Rollback policy: auto-rollback if error rate >1.2% sustained for 4m OR p95 latency >1.5s for 6m. Also manual rollback if KV-cache mismatch during canary. I'll be monitoring dashboards.

otto (prod-eng): Pinned image: rwinference:v2026-07-11-hotfixA. Config: batch=adaptive, kv_cache=enabled, quant=fp16. Note: telemetry shows slight warmup spike on mem for first 5 min.

claire (solutions): Customer requests: canary cadence 8%/20m -> 25%/15m -> 60%/10m -> full. They want a 1-hour post-deploy summary (latency, token cost, error trends). Also require a manual OK from CS before final 100%.

ben-cs: I'll be present in the customer channel and will withhold final OK until customer verifies synthetic run during the 25% stage.

deploybot: Preflight checks: capacity=OK, certs=OK, smoke-tests=OK, image=available, sec-scan=OK. Scheduling canary for 1767778200 (00:30 UTC).

donna: Ops command for reference:
```
rb deploy --team=helixflow --env=dedicated \
  --image=rwinference:v2026-07-11-hotfixA \
  --canary=8%:20m,25%:15m,60%:10m --kv-cache=on --quant=fp16
```

security-bot: Reminder: if customer requests add'l logging, ensure PII redaction toggle is enabled (env var RW_PII_REDACT=true).

donna: Final go/no-go - please react with :thumbsup: to approve, :thumbsdown: to hold. Post any holds with reason.

felix (platform): :thumbsup: infra green.

rachel (sre): :thumbsup: I'll be on-call and watching alerts.

otto (prod-eng): :thumbsup: image tested in staging; mem warmup noted but within tolerance.

claire (solutions): :thumbsup: CS ready.

ben-cs: :thumbsup: customer standby confirmed.

donna: Locking schedule. I'll post a 30m reminder and a 5m countdown. deploybot will post live rollout events in-thread. If anyone flags a hold, post it here immediately.

deploybot: Job queued for 1767778200. Will update at canary start, ramp steps, and completion.
